svg.title: Sidira mark — founder-mode (dual-color)
svg.desc: Six-blade diaphragm with three Sid-blue (#2C5577) blades on the left and three Avira-rose (#D696C8) blades on the right. Geometry identical to sidira-mark.svg. Used on brand-mode surfaces (DESIGN.md §1.3: favicon / app icon, public site, about, press kit, social avatar, anniversary, investor-deck page one) and as the held frame inside the in-product aperture-close animation. Default elsewhere is sidira-mark.svg.
